title: HBB2OBB: Horizontal to Oriented Bounding Box Conversion and Evaluation Tool
description:
HBB2OBB converts horizontal (axis-aligned) bounding boxes into oriented (rotated) bounding boxes by using existing HBB annotations as prompts for segmentation models from the SAM (Segment Anything Model) family. It targets object detection tasks where objects appear at arbitrary orientations, such as aerial imagery, satellite data, and traffic monitoring, producing oriented boxes that tightly encapsulate non-upright objects without any re-annotation. Beyond conversion, it provides evaluation, hyperparameter optimization, and annotation format-conversion tools, exposed through both a command-line interface and a Python API.

Why HBB2OBB

  • 🎯 Accurate OBBs from HBBs: prompts SAM-family segmentation models with existing horizontal boxes to fit tight oriented boxes around non-upright objects, with no re-annotation required.
  • 🧩 Model ensemble: combines masks from multiple SAM variants through majority voting for more robust, accurate results.
  • 🛡️ Spatially constrained and safe: region-specific masking and contour refinement keep segmentation inside the object, and a fallback retains the original HBB when no valid mask is found.
  • 📐 Flexible scaling: positive or negative scale factors, optionally different for the short and long sides, recover cropped object parts or tighten overly conservative annotations.
  • 📊 Evaluate and optimize: built-in IoU evaluation against ground truth plus a hyperparameter optimizer over SAM inference resolution and scale factors.
  • 🔄 Format conversions: utilities to move between YOLO TXT and COCO, Pascal VOC, and LabelMe JSON annotations.

Features

  • HBB to OBB conversion of YOLO-format annotations using SAM-based segmentation.
  • Multiple model support: SAM, SAM2, SAM2.1, SAM3, Mobile SAM, and FastSAM families.
  • Model ensemble via majority voting for enhanced accuracy.
  • Evaluation tools to assess OBB accuracy against ground truth using IoU metrics.
  • Hyperparameter optimization over SAM inference resolutions and HBB scale factors.
  • Visualization tools for HBBs, segmentation masks, derived contours, and resulting OBBs.
  • Format conversion utilities between LabelMe, COCO, and Pascal VOC annotations and YOLO TXT.

Planned Enhancements

  • Improved morphological operations for better mask refinement.
  • Integration with popular object detection libraries to alleviate the need for HBB annotations.
  • Support for additional segmentation models beyond the SAM and FastSAM families.

Related Projects

  • Geo-trax 🚀: end-to-end framework for extracting georeferenced vehicle trajectories from drone imagery. HBB2OBB can enhance its outputs when object orientation is needed for downstream analysis.
  • Stabilo 🌀: Python library for video and trajectory stabilization using robust homography transformations, supporting oriented bounding boxes among its mask formats.
